title: Fee Refunds on Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup and Mobile Wallet Transfers: Refunds and Fees Callbacks
content:
For a callback on refunds and fees to a Personal Sender Account holder, fee refunds are the refunds of fees on the customer's Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup and Mobile Wallet transfers dated in the 12 months before the callback request date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting.

| Fee refunds in the 12 months | Business days added to the counted fees callback window |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 |
| exactly 1 | 1 |
| none | 0 |

When there are 2 or more fee refunds, 2 business days are added to the counted fees callback window; when there is exactly 1, 1 business day is added; when there is none, nothing is added for fee refunds.

## The entries counted

Each fee refunded entry in the ledger of one of the customer's transfers — Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup or Mobile Wallet — is one fee refund, counted by its entry date. The count is of refund entries, whatever their amounts; refunds of principal are not fee refunds.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- One Cash Pickup fee refund and one Mobile Wallet fee refund in the 12 months: 2 fee refunds, 2 business days added.
- One Bank Deposit fee refund in the 12 months, and another dated on the same calendar day 12 months before the callback request date: only 1 counts, 1 business day added.
- A principal refund on a cancelled Cash Pickup transfer and no fee refund: nothing added.
